notes.title: Spells 'n' Stuff Re-Released: Early Access Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]It's here, it's time![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12722560/62858a90a2d9245d3db10473f12f4ea6234b7431.jpg[/img]

Firstly, thank you to anyone who has been following the development of Spells 'n' Stuff over the past year (or longer), your support means a lot.

The early access build of the game is now live on Steam [b]and is available free to everyone who has bought Spells 'n' Stuff in the past[/b], I can't wait to hear player's feedback and begin working on improvements for the game.


Since my last post on here, here's some of the changes I've made to the game:

[list]
[*]Added player health system, rather than having one-shot kills
[*]Added three new spells
[*]Added spell pickups and a mana/ammo system
[*]Added in-game positional voice chat
[*]Tons of new sound effects
[*]Hit detection is now all done server-side
[*]Changed how respawning works
[*]Player's now get knocked back when hit
[*]Added a proper pause menu, with voice chat settings
[*]Improvements to the flying system
[*]Various graphical changes
[*]UI design improvements
[*]A crazy amount of bug fixes, too many to list
[/list]
...and much more!


[b]You can check out the trailer here:[/b]

[previewyoutube=i2cGMnms71M;full][/previewyoutube]


Join us on Discord:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/NWvxzRQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12722560/db7a4de31e45ad4e227655e1e4cc2ebf8213dc64.png[/img][/url]


Thanks for reading! Have fun!

- Luke (novo)

notes.title: Spells 'n' Stuff Re-Release Announcement
notes.content:
Many personal life-events have gotten in the way since the initial launch of Spells 'n' Stuff, but I'm finally pleased to announce that I've been working on a remake, built from the ground up, for the past year, so we're close to getting Spells 'n' Stuff re-released!

It's not quite ready yet (still some polishing to do), but will come in a free update to the original game, to those who already own it. The purchase option will also return once the remake update is out.

Thank you so much to the people who supported the original version, I apologise for the long wait!


[h2]Here's what's new:[/h2]


[h3]New Spell Casting[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12722560/22449765887dfc69e436e2ca260fce069f315099.png[/img]
[i]One spell fits all[/i]

I've reworked the way that the wand works, you now hold the trigger, point upwards, spin to charge it and release the trigger to fire. I think this feels quite satisfying, like you're putting actual energy into the spell.

You can also cast spells on various objects that sparkle when you're holding your wand.

[h3]One-hit kills[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12722560/0772d12e1448a5d47f02e70f278bf1dacf9b77aa.png[/img]
[i]None of that weak magic nonsense, how can you call yourself magical if your spells don't do the job?[/i]

Spells 'n' Stuff is hard, having good accuracy is rewarded with one-hit kills.

[h3]Flying![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12722560/2380076dae45fb974a61d30804e09d2a122d9a61.png[/img]
[i]Just being able to teleport wasn't cutting it, now you can fly up and touch the moon![/i]

Pointing your wand down and holding the trigger makes you fly upwards, away from where you're aiming.

It's not the only way of getting around, teleportation by throwing bouncy potions is still there, combining the two makes combat very interesting.

This feature has only recently been added, tweaks are gonna be needed to the physics and comfort of it, but from what's been tested, it works really well.


[h3]Even more stuff![/h3]



There's so much stuff I could cover, so here's a quick list:
[list]
[*]Valve Index Knuckles support
[*]Updated/new maps
[*]Potion physics improved
[*]Goodbye temporary voxel models
[*]Networking now uses Steam P2P
[*]HANDS
[*]Ambidextrous controls
[*]Offline bot matches
[/list]

If you want more info on the changes, check out the first Devlog video:
[previewyoutube=Vvg-plpSp-c;full][/previewyoutube]


Thanks for reading!

Check out my Twitter for more updates (it's at the bottom of this post).

Join the discord: https://discord.com/invite/NWvxzRQ

Keep an eye out for the release announcement on here, no date yet, just when it's ready.

notes.title: Major Update 1.26 - Singleplayer Castle Defence + Improvements
notes.content:
Hey everyone, been planning this update for a while. I apologise for the delay, I haven't had as much time as I would like to work on the game the past two months, but now I have all the time I need.

Changes:

+New singleplayer Castle Defence mode.
+Moved to using "The Lab Renderer".
+New wand sound effects.
+You now fire the wand pressing the Grip button, holding the trigger charges the shot.
+New main menu layout, with a NAT Punchthrough toggle button incase your router does not support it.
+Upgraded to Unity 5.4
+Maps now have ambient sounds.
+Fixed and added anti-cheat colliders to multiplayer maps.
+Multiplayer troubleshooting is now clearer.
+Controls are now displayed on the main menu.
+Improved lighting on all maps.
+Improved performance overall.

~Fixed main menu and lobby controllers clicking,
~Replaced old hand model with new staff in the lobby.

The next update will focus on improving the multiplayer side of things and adding achievements.

Hope you enjoy!

You can follow development progress on the Trello board: https://trello.com/b/sprTWcYU

Please report any bugs you find to the Steam Discussions.

notes.title: Minor Update Alpha 1.25
notes.content:
Hey, just thought I'd push out a small update for the multiplayer, it's mostly aesthetic changes.

+New wand projectile.
+New projectile smoke.
+New projectile smoke sound.
+Potion cooldown timer.

-Removed experimental dust particle effects from the main menu.

The reason this update is quite small is that I've been focusing on a singleplayer "Castle Defence" gamemode, which is not quite finished yet, but prepare for an update in the near future.

If you find any bugs, please let me know on the Steam community forums.

notes.title: Patch notes for Spells 'n' Stuff 1.24 Alpha
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope you enjoy this update. I've worked on mostly bugs and improving how the game works.

+You now hold the trigger on the wand to charge the shot.
+You may no longer need to port forward, I've enabled experimental NAT punchthrough support.
+New main menu.
+New staff model that replaces the hand.
+Wand smoke particle is larger.

-Removed hand model.

~You can now join games that are already in progress.
~Timers no longer show decimals on the wand.
~Clients now see the "You Win!" and "You Lose!" thing at the end of the game.

You can follow what I'm working on before I release the updates here: https://trello.com/b/sprTWcYU

Thanks for playing!
